nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 先建立业务相关性
nodes.message:
Hi,

Are repetitive modeling tasks and file handoffs crowding out time to refine your game assets?

Tripo Studio Team Plan turns text or images into first-pass 3D characters and props. Your artists refine them in their existing tools, while shared credits and a shared asset library support creation and reuse.

Want to evaluate this workflow for your team? Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

重复建模和文件交接，是否正在挤占完善游戏资产的时间？

Tripo Studio 团队版可从文字或图片生成角色与道具的初始3D模型。美术成员在现有工具中继续精修，团队则通过共享积分和共享资产库开展制作与复用。

想评估这套流程是否适合你的团队？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 从初始模型到团队复用
nodes.message:
Generate initial models from text or images, then refine geometry and materials in your existing tools and check them in the game.

Shared credits, access controls and a searchable asset library keep team resources together. Teammates can find and reuse reviewed assets rather than request another file handoff.

Want to evaluate this workflow for your team? Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
从文字或图片生成初始模型，再在现有工具中完善几何与材质，并在游戏中检查。

想评估这套流程是否适合你的团队？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 评估完整流程投入
nodes.message:
For a focused evaluation, you could start with 10 real characters and props. Set project requirements, then compare your current process with generation, cleanup, review and engine checks.

Record credits, retries, artist time and whether teammates can find and reuse approved assets. Count the full effort, not only generation time.

Want to evaluate this workflow for your team? Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 业务需要与10项资产试点
nodes.message:
Hi,

Is your next asset milestone being held up by repeated modeling and file handoffs?

Tripo Studio Team Plan combines text/image-to-3D generation with one workspace, pooled credits and member access controls. Artists can refine starting models in their existing tools, while teammates find shared assets without another file request.

Evaluate 10 real characters or props against your current process: time to a useful model, cleanup, review, handoffs and reuse. Leave your details to plan the pilot scope and access with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

下一阶段的资产交付，是否被重复建模和文件交接拖慢？

Tripo Studio 团队版将文字／图片生成3D与统一工作区、共享积分及成员权限结合。美术可在现有工具中继续精修初始模型，其他成员则能找到共享资产，不必再次索取文件。

用10项真实角色或道具对照现有流程：记录获得可用初始模型的时间、精修、审核、交接和复用。留下联系方式，与 Tripo 规划试点范围及使用安排。

nodes.message:

Explore the examples, or plan the pilot around your own assets.

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 10项资产的验收及完整投入
nodes.message:
Choose 10 live characters or props. Agree on style, topology, polygon budget, UVs, rigging where needed, export format and engine checks before testing.

Compare your current workflow with generation, retries, artist refinement, review and in-game checks. Record credits, time to a useful starting model, artist hours, time to approval and accepted assets out of 10. Count reuse, file handoffs and admin time too.

Keep input sources, generation settings, review decisions and final versions in your project records, following your disclosure and review policies. Your team decides what ships. Leave your details to agree on scope, access and who runs the pilot.
nodes.messageZh:
选择10项项目中的真实角色或道具。测试前先确定风格、拓扑、面数预算、UV、必要的绑定、导出格式及引擎检查标准。

对照现有流程，记录生成、重试、美术精修、审核和游戏内检查。统计积分、获得可用初始模型的时间、美术工时、通过验收的时间及10项中的通过数量，同时统计复用次数、文件交接次数和管理耗时。

在项目记录中保留输入来源、生成设置、审核决定和最终版本，并遵循自己的内容标注和审核要求。由你的团队决定哪些资产进入项目。留下联系方式，商定试点范围、使用安排和执行分工。

Review the requests in Quick Start, or leave your details to discuss a 10-asset benchmark.

Hi,

Use 3D to show product form from more than one angle, starting with images your team already has.

Tripo API generates 3D assets from product images, so your team can use an existing generation layer rather than develop its own model. Submit a task, check its status and retrieve the result for review and use in your platform.

See the path from an image to a reviewed display asset, or check what to assess first. Open Quick Start to prepare the integration.
